name: apple-compliance
description: Prepare Apple-platform apps for policy review, privacy evidence, signing, metadata, TestFlight, submission and distribution with source-backed checks.

interface.longDescription: Prepare Apple-platform apps for review and distribution using source-backed workflows for App Store policies, privacy, SDK manifests, authentication, digital goods, content, entitlements, metadata, TestFlight, submission, rejection handling and macOS distribution. Preserve unknown product facts and current storefront/agreements. Includes original reference libraries, safe evidence helpers and native Codex, Claude Code and Kimi packaging.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this app and prepare an evidence-backed Apple submission readiness report with concrete blockers and unknowns.
Review this privacy, commerce, account, or content issue against current Apple sources and the actual app behavior.
Help me complete the authorized Apple submission or distribution stage without confusing upload, review, and release.
